name: @velaros-ai/tool-contract
description: The tool contract shared by capability spaces: declare a tool once (identity, category, role, permissions, capability schema, exposure), render and police its model-facing description, turn its zod schema into JSON Schema or a compact bundle, mount a whole space onto the kernel, and build the one failure envelope every space reports.
author: VelarOS

scripts.build: bun run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/capabilities/build/fix-esm-extensions.mjs dist && node ../../scripts/build/normalize-package-declarations.mjs
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test spec/acceptance.test.ts test/tool-descriptions.test.ts test/tool-schemas.test.ts
